name: Jadard Technology Inc.
summary: Jadard Technology Inc. engages in the research, design, development, and sale of mobile smart terminals in China and internationally. The company offers display driver chips for mobile smart terminals, camera voice coil motor driver chips, fast charging protocol chips, touch and display driver integration driver chips, and ESL chips.
